threads.body: The committed `data.json` still contains findings for `com.anthropic.sdk.python` and `anthropic.messages.create`, so the published results retain the SDK telemetry this setting disables. Without regenerating it, CI's coverage-freshness check will fail when it compares the new results with the committed report. Run `otel-conformance scenarios/gen-ai/python/anthropic/opentelemetry-langchain-anthropic --report-only` and commit the regenerated `data.json` alongside this change.

+  ANTHROPIC_OPEN_TELEMETRY: "false"

threads.body: Non-blocking follow-up idea: as #459 showed, a dependency refresh can quietly add SDK spans to a non-native report. The runner could catch this by flagging scopes other than the declared instrumentation, or by setting `ANTHROPIC_OPEN_TELEMETRY=false` by default outside `native`.
